reading.title: Helping in the kitchen
reading.text: On Sundays I help my mother in the kitchen. First I wash the vegetables in the sink. My mother puts a big saucepan on the cooker and makes soup. I put the plates, bowls and spoons on the table. My little brother brings the glasses. After dinner we do the washing-up. I wash the plates and my brother dries them with a tea towel.

listening.title: My small kitchen
listening.script: This is my kitchen. It is small, but I like it. On the left there is a big fridge with a freezer. Next to the fridge there is the cooker. The sink is under the window. There is a cupboard above the sink. It has cups, mugs and plates in it. On the table there is a bowl of apples. There is no dishwasher, so I always do the washing-up by hand.

reading.title: My morning
reading.text: I wake up at seven o'clock when my alarm clock rings. I get up and go to the bathroom. First I have a shower with soap and shampoo. Then I dry myself with a big towel. I clean my teeth with toothpaste and comb my hair in front of the mirror. After that I go back to my bedroom and get dressed. I take my clothes from the wardrobe. At night I read for a little and then I fall asleep.

listening.title: Emma's bedroom
listening.script: This is Emma's room. There is a bed against the wall and a small bedside table next to it. On the table there is a lamp and an alarm clock. Opposite the bed there is a big wardrobe and a chest of drawers. There is a mirror on the wall above the chest of drawers. Emma goes to bed at eleven o'clock. She turns off the light and falls asleep quickly.

reading.title: Our living room
reading.text: Our living room is the biggest room in our flat. There is a large sofa and two armchairs. In front of the sofa there is a small coffee table. On the floor there is a soft carpet. On the wall there is a picture of mountains. In the evening we all sit together. My father watches TV, my mother reads a book and I listen to music. Sometimes my little brother takes the remote control and we cannot find it.

listening.script: I am going to tell you about my grandparents' living room. It is old but very nice. There is a big wooden bookshelf with a lot of books. There are red curtains on the window. reading.title: Jobs in my family
reading.text: My family has many different jobs. My father is a taxi driver. He drives around the city all day and he likes meeting people. My mother is a nurse. She works in a big hospital, and sometimes she works at night. My uncle is a farmer and he has a small farm with cows. My older sister wants to be an engineer. She studies at university. I want to be a police officer.

listening.title: Three jobs
listening.script: Hello. I am Rustam and I am a waiter. I work in a restaurant in the city centre. I start work at ten o'clock and finish at eight in the evening. I like my job because I meet many interesting people. My friend Sardor is a bank clerk. He works in an office and he thinks his job is a bit boring. My sister is a hairdresser and she works in a beauty salon.

reading.title: My school day
reading.text: My school day starts at eight o'clock. On Mondays we have maths, history and biology. I love biology because the teacher shows us interesting pictures of animals. I do not like chemistry very much. It is difficult for me. At break time I eat an apple and talk to my friends. In the PE lesson we play football. In the afternoon we do art. I draw with a pencil and use a rubber when I make a mistake. After school I do my homework at my desk.
